runtime_probe: implement GetPathOfRootfsProbeConfig This function will return path of model specific probe config if it exists, otherwise, return default probe config. Model specific probe config: /etc/runtime_probe/<model_name>/probe_config.json Default (common) probe config: /etc/runtime_probe/probe_config.json For boards not using unibuild, <model_name> will fallback to board name. CQ-DEPEND=CL:1390797 BUG=b:121997371 TEST=emerge-${BOARD} runtime_probe & cros deploy TEST=PROTO_BYTES=$(echo -e 'categories:battery\ncategories:audio_codec' \ | protoc --encode runtime_probe.ProbeRequest \ system_api/dbus/runtime_probe/runtime_probe.proto \ | hexdump -v -e '/1 "%d,"'); \ ssh root@$ACTIVE_DUT sudo -u chronos \ dbus-send --system --print-reply \ --type=method_call --dest=org.chromium.RuntimeProbe \ /org/chromium/RuntimeProbe org.chromium.RuntimeProbe.ProbeCategories \ array:byte:$PROTO_BYTES and see the expected failure & loading path from /var/log/message Change-Id: I06e9714b0f031af2543d4b3cc5ca9bdb970df320 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1390033 Commit-Ready: Chun-ta Lin <itspeter@chromium.org> Tested-by: Chun-ta Lin <itspeter@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chun-ta Lin <itspeter@chromium.org>
